people.name: Red_Sea
people.line: Sea crossed by Israelites in the Exodus

translations.web: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.
translations.bsb: At the sound of their fall the earth will quake; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.
translations.kjv: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
translations.asv: The earth trembleth at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise whereof is heard in the Red Sea.
